notes: Competing reading for s008: treating *is able* as a supplied lexical verb and leaving only *to stand* with the verb; rejected because the modal frame is what the ASV writes for one finite verb and rule 17 keeps auxiliaries with it.
The corpus fuses לִפְנֵי to *before* in 597 units; the split is not defensible here since no English word writes פָּנֶה's own lexeme.
